resource_name: UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project pQTL summary statistics
participants: 54,219 profiled in UKB-PPP; pQTL comparison analysis: 46,218 British/Irish, 1,513 African, 953 South Asian
protein_assays_and_targets: 2,923 unique proteins; 2,931 Olink assays in comparison paper
pQTL_summary: 14,287 primary associations in consortium report; 2,102 sentinel cis and 24,824 sentinel trans in British/Irish pQTL analysis; ancestry-specific summary statistics also reported
ancestry: UK Biobank British/Irish, African and South Asian strata
access_and_license_status: AWS Registry page labels the resource CC BY and the S3 bucket Controlled Access; Synapse project includes a file-query entity view, but object-level access and file-specific reuse terms/build must be checked for any selected pQTL file before use
genome_build: Not verified in source pages reviewed
ukb_overlap: Direct UKB cohort overlap is high/expected; use only as molecular context, never independent replication
other_overlap: Potential overlap with UKB-based aging outcomes unknown until specific summary source/cohort checked
query_plan: After eligible sleep-frailty loci freeze, identify the matching assay and ancestry-specific file through the Synapse metadata/entity view; verify file permission, schema, build, effect scale and license before targeted retrieval; do not assume CC BY label settles S3 object access
limitations: Olink and SomaScan can disagree in assay/protein mapping and association; per-protein assay IDs, effect scale, build, N, and access terms must be confirmed per file; no data downloaded. Synapse file listing/download route and current permissions were not tested

resource_name: deCODE Icelandic plasma proteomics pQTL summary statistics
protein_assays_and_targets: 4,907 aptamer assays; 4,719 proteins in the underlying SomaScan release
pQTL_summary: 2,120 sentinel cis and 22,616 sentinel trans pQTLs in the 2023 comparison analysis
ancestry: Icelandic; ancestry label/build require file-level confirmation
access_and_license_status: Publisher article states GWAS summary statistics for all 2,931 Olink and 4,907 SomaScan assays are available at deCODE; official listing labels combined release 19.7 TB; current download form requires JavaScript, so per-file targeted route and license remain unverified
genome_build: Not verified in source pages reviewed
ukb_overlap: No UKB participant overlap expected for this Icelandic cohort; do not assume independence from all Icelandic frailty/aging GWAS without cohort confirmation
other_overlap: Potential overlap with deCODE/Icelandic aging outcomes; check study-specific cohort and sample source
query_plan: After eligible loci freeze, query only required protein assay and locus; establish whether locus-targeted delivery exists before any bulk transfer
limitations: Platform and aptamer-specificity differences matter; public full release is extremely large; genotype build, per-file N/effect scale, license and targeted retrieval remain to verify; no data downloaded
